content_sections.heading: Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Income Tax Department, Delhi Region, has announced 119 vacancies across three posts. The vacancies are tentative and may change according to administrative requirements. Candidates can apply for one or more posts if they meet the eligibility requirements for each post, but only one application should be submitted.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Delhi Sports-Wise Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notification distributes the recruitment opportunities across 27 sports disciplines , with 67 men's and 52 women's vacancies. Important: The sport-wise vacancies are tentative and subject to change or reallocation. The department may consider eligible sportspersons from other notified disciplines where the prescribed conditions permit.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Qualification Cut-off: Candidates must have acquired the prescribed educational qualifications on or before 31 August 2026 . Tax Assistant: Selected candidates must complete the prescribed computer data-entry skill test at a speed of 8,000 key depressions per hour. Stenographer Grade-II: Candidates must pass the stenography skill test involving dictation at 80 words per minute for 10 minutes. The prescribed transcription duration is 50 minutes in English or 65 minutes in Hindi on a computer.

rows.educational_qualification: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university or equivalent qualification. Selected candidates must also pass the prescribed skill test requiring a data-entry speed of 8,000 key depressions per hour within the stipulated time.
12th Pass or equivalent from a recognized board. Selected candidates must pass the prescribed stenography skill test.
10th Pass or equivalent from a recognized board.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is determined as of 31 August 2026 . Eligible meritorious sportspersons can receive upper-age relaxation of up to 5 years under Government of India instructions. For eligible SC/ST sportspersons, the relaxation may extend up to 10 years . Age relaxation is available only to candidates satisfying the prescribed sports eligibility and other recruitment requirements.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notified posts carry the following 7th Central Pay Commission pay levels. The above pay ranges correspond to the notified pay levels under the Central Government pay matrix. Applicable allowances and service conditions will be governed by relevant government rules.

content_sections.heading: Sports Eligibility for Income Tax Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must have recognized sporting achievements in the events and competitions prescribed by the notification. Sports performance achieved between 1 January 2020 and 15 October 2026 will be considered. The notification establishes the following order of preference for eligible sportspersons: Candidates representing India in recognized international competitions, with the required sports-authority clearance. Candidates representing a State or Union Territory in recognized Senior or Junior National Championships and securing the prescribed medal or position. Candidates representing a university in Inter-University competitions and securing the prescribed position. Candidates representing a State or Union Territory in eligible Khelo India Games competitions. Candidates representing State Schools in recognized National School Games competitions and securing the prescribed position. Candidates representing a State, Union Territory, University or State School team at the specified competition level without winning a medal or position. Important: Sporting achievement certificates must be issued by the competent authorities and submitted in the prescribed formats. Participation or achievement outside the recognized competition categories does not automatically establish eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Sports Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: The notification specifies authorized certificate-issuing authorities for different categories of sports competitions. Candidates must use the relevant certificate forms prescribed in Annexure-II of the notification. Sports certificates issued in formats not prescribed by the notification will not be accepted.

rows.authorized_certificate_issuing_authority: Secretary of the concerned National Federation or National Association
Secretary of the concerned National Federation or State Association
Dean of Sports or another officer in overall charge of university sports
Director or Additional/Joint/Deputy Director responsible for school sports in the state public instruction or education directorate
Designated Sports Authority of India or Khelo India official, as specified

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment process focuses on the candidates' sports achievements, consistency of performance, age, educational qualifications and suitability for the posts. Scrutiny of Online Applications and Supporting Documents Shortlisting based on Sports Achievements and Eligibility Verification of Sports Certificates and Other Documents Applicable Skill Test or Assessment Requirements Final Selection and Appointment, subject to departmental verification The department may evaluate sports achievements according to the notified order of preference and eligibility rules. Shortlisting or inclusion in a provisional merit list does not itself guarantee appointment.

content_sections.heading: Appointment and Probation Conditions
content_sections.text: The notification states that selected candidates will be posted in the Delhi Region and placed on probation for two years or such period as prescribed by the applicable government rules. Selected sportspersons may be required to represent the department in tournaments and sports activities in accordance with departmental conditions. The notification also contains provisions concerning minimum service obligations and inter-charge transfers.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Income Tax Delhi website at www.incometaxdelhi.gov.in . Open the Sports Recruitment section. Read the Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 notification and the instructions for candidates. Verify your eligibility for the selected post and sporting discipline. Open the online application form and complete the required personal, educational and sports achievement details. Upload the prescribed sports certificates and other supporting documents. Review the completed application using the Preview or Print option. Submit the application online before 10 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Save the application acknowledgement or submitted application copy for future reference. Application Warning: Candidates must submit only one application, even if eligible for multiple posts. The application should clearly indicate the order of preference for the posts. Multiple applications may be rejected as specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Recruitment
content_sections.text: 10th or Matriculation Certificate for proof of date of birth Aadhaar Card Educational qualification marksheets and certificates Prescribed Sports Achievement Certificate issued by the competent authority Community or Caste Certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable No Objection Certificate for serving government or eligible organizational employees, where applicable Other supporting documents required by the notification and application portal Uploaded documents must be clear, legible and in the prescribed format. Original certificates will be required during the relevant verification stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 119 vacancies, including 44 Tax Assistant, 9 Stenographer Grade-II and 66 Multi-Tasking Staff posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 10 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Can candidates without sports achievements apply?
faq.answer: No. This recruitment is meant for meritorious sportspersons who meet the prescribed sports participation and achievement criteria.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for Tax Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university or equivalent and satisfy the prescribed data-entry skill test requirement.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for Stenographer Grade-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th standard or equivalent and must satisfy the specified stenography skill test requirements.

faq.question: Q6. Can 10th Pass candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with a 10th Pass or equivalent qualification may apply for the Multi-Tasking Staff post if they also satisfy the prescribed sports eligibility and age requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18–27 years for Tax Assistant and Stenographer Grade-II and 18–25 years for MTS as of 31 August 2026, with eligible sports quota relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Tax Assistant and Stenographer?
faq.answer: Both posts carry Pay Level 4 under the 7th Central Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection involves scrutiny of applications, evaluation of recognized sports achievements, eligibility verification and applicable assessments. Final selection is subject to the department's prescribed recruitment conditions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply online?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply through the Sports Recruitment section of the official Income Tax Delhi website.
